title: Lero
tagline: Liquid restaking made easy with AI agents
description: This project lets users deposit funds with an AI agent that monitors the yield, TVL and other factors on liquid restaking platforms like Renzo, EtherFi, KelpDAO on Base and automatically rebalances it whenever they change to provide the highest return to the users. This agent therefore acts like an LRT aggregator and optimiser without needing user input.
how_its_made: This project uses Coinbase's AgentKit to run the AI agent which is also deployed on Autonome so users can interact with it there directly. I have added plugins for Renzo, Etherfi and KelpDAO to AgentKit so that users can deposit assets there through a chat interface as well. The yield and TVL monitoring is done through publicly accessible APIs of the platforms and rebalancing is done through prompt-engineering on GPT-4o.
